name: Prasanth
quote: Every tool that goes out is checked out against a customer and a rental period, and the cost is worked out for us when it comes back. We were running all of this in registers before and losing track of what was still outside. Now a single screen tells us what is pending, and following up on returns takes minutes.

name: Ajmal
quote: The weighing scale integration works exactly the way it should — the weight comes straight into the bill with no manual typing and no mistakes. The VFD display on the customer side is a big plus, because the customer can see what is being weighed and what it costs while it happens. It has removed a lot of arguments at the counter for us.

name: Athul
quote: The reception kiosk handles walk-ins on its own — the customer picks a service, answers only the questions that service needs, and signs the disclaimer on the tablet. The booking is waiting in Odoo for our receptionist to approve by the time they sit down. Our front desk is no longer the queue it used to be.

name: Shahib
quote: The billing application runs on the counter PC itself, so it stays quick even on the older machines we did not want to replace yet. When the connection drops it keeps taking bills and syncs everything back once we are online again. That alone has saved us more days of trading than I can count.

name: Gabriel Machial
quote: They trained our people at each stage of the rollout rather than handing everything over in one session at the end. Each team learnt its own part while that part was going live, so nobody was sitting in front of a screen they had never seen. Adoption did not stall the way it did with the system we used before.

name: Sri
quote: We had a workflow no off-the-shelf product covered, and they built the web application around it instead of asking us to change how we work. The parts we were doing by hand between three tools now happen in one place. It behaves the way our operation actually runs, which is the whole reason we went custom.

name: Krithik
quote: We never have to explain our setup from scratch, because the same people who built it are the ones who answer the phone. A small change stays a small change instead of turning into a proposal and a wait. It is much closer to having our own IT team than to raising tickets with a vendor.

name: Anushiya
quote: They handed over documented deployment steps along with the code, so our own team can run and update the system without calling anyone. Everything we need is written down in plain language rather than locked in someone's head. That is the difference between owning the software and renting it.

name: Shamnad
quote: The support they give is easily the best part of working with them. Whenever we raise an issue, someone responds quickly and stays on it until it is completely resolved, no matter what time of day it is. That kind of reliability is rare and it is the main reason we continue with them.
